title: Mexico Bonds Trade Like Junk After $130 Billion Bailout of Pemex
summary: Long the poster child of fiscal probity in emerging markets, Mexico was, at its peak, an A-rated borrower in the bond market just a few years ago. Today, the country finds itself teetering on the cusp of junk status and paying interest rates that are higher than those offered by tiny neighbors with lower credit ratings, like Guatemala and Panama.

title: China Defends Cooperation With Iran Amid US Warnings | Opening Trade 8/25/2026
summary:
Beijing threatened to retaliate against the US and signaled it won’t back away from its cooperation with Iran after the Trump administration’s latest sanctions targeted businesses in China and Hong Kong. Bessent unveiled dozens of new sanctions on entities, individuals and vessels, but the main thrust of a high-profile press conference was threatening so-called secondary sanctions against companies and countries that continue doing business with Iran.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
